verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an asynchronous job model where webhooks fire on job completion or failure instead of long polling. Cost Optimizer is explicitly aimed at long mixed-complexity documents. Both indirectly suggest large documents are handled without request timeouts. Nothing in the pack documents page-count or file-size limits, multi-gigabyte handling, or guarantees against silent truncation. missing for 10: documented max page/file-size limits, evidence of thousand-page or multi-GB processing, truncation/partial-result signaling, independent hands-on corroboration of large-file reliability.
